findings.title: Reject weapon commands when the gunner is the empty-seat sentinel
findings.claim: With Weapons unattended, a command from player -1 is reported as applied even though no present player occupies Weapons and the tactical step ignores it.
findings.evidence: src/renderer/src/sim/duel/step.ts:L39 returns -1 for an unattended station; L105 checks only player !== gunner. A direct probe after player 1 stands reproduced applied results for player -1's lock, charge and launch, with no corresponding weapon action. This violates spec L273 and plan L45.
findings.why: The local DuelEnvelope accepts a numeric player ID, and admission currently confuses an invalid actor with the absence of an actor. Command results therefore disagree with execution.
findings.fix: Reject when gunner < 0 as well as when the player differs from gunner. Add a regression using player -1 with Weapons vacant and with its occupant away.

findings.title: Exercise populated missiles and events in the clone regression
findings.claim: The clone test does not verify independent copying of missile objects or event records.
findings.evidence: tests/tacticalDeterminism.test.ts:L80 creates seed 13 and advances 900 ticks before cloning at L82. A direct probe confirmed missiles=[null,null] and events=[] at that point. The mutations at L87 cover only rooms, graceUntil, trail and RNG. Replaying all its assertions with shallow missile/event copies still passed, leaving src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/state.ts:L107 and L109 unprotected.
findings.why: The test claims comprehensive independence but misses mutable objects needed by the upcoming snapshot and rollback integration. A shallow-copy regression would pass this test.
findings.fix: Populate both missile slots and representative laser/missileEnd events before cloning. Assert equal contents and distinct references, mutate the copied objects, and verify the originals remain unchanged. Retain the identical-future check.
